a.text: Honest concern: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so if we both operate in round 1 we almost certainly both die with empty units. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one of us. I'd rather agree openly than defect on you. Proposal: we flip by round parity — I take 4 in round 1, and if no storm hits, I give back or operate to help get you to 4. Tell me if you object or have a fairer plan; I won't hide what I do.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. You declined my proposal, so I'm keeping the agreement and operating. I'll take only when the reserve reaches 8, and only 4.
